name: BKND
title: bknd.io
shortDescription: BKND is a lightweight, feature-rich backend solution designed for modern developers. It integrates seamlessly with various frameworks like NextJS, Remix, and more, or can run standalone in environments like Bun, Node, and Deno. Ideal for projects requiring scalable backend services with features like data management, authentication, and media handling. Example use case: A startup developing a web app requiring robust backend services without the overhead of larger platforms.
cons: Newer in the market, less proven
